snippet.title: Chapter 2 Teaser Trailer - A Difficult Game About Climbing
snippet.description:
NEW MAP RELEASING AUGUST 25! INCLUDED FOR FREE WITH THE BASE GAME!

Get the game on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2497920/A_Difficult_Game_About_Climbing/

I've been cooking! I spent a year making an entire new map for A Difficult Game About Climbing. It's BETTER, BIGGER and HARDER than the first map!

Climb, slip and fall again in this massive map expansion to the original game
